resource.name: AdministeredBy
resource.description: Identifies who administers the medication.

resource.name: Allergy Intolerance
resource.description: Risk of harmful or undesirable physiological response which is specific to an individual and associated with exposure to a substance.

resource.name: Care Plan
resource.description: Describes the intention of how one or more practitioners intend to deliver care for a particular patient, group or community for a period of time, possibly limited to care for a specific condition or set of conditions.

resource.name: Care Team
resource.description: The Care Team includes all the people and organizations who plan to participate in the coordination and delivery of care.

resource.name: CommunicationMethod
resource.description: Communication Method

resource.name: CompanyName
resource.description: Company Name

resource.name: Condition
resource.description: A clinical condition, problem, diagnosis, or other event, situation, issue, or clinical concept that has risen to a level of concern.

resource.name: Context
resource.description: Context

resource.name: Coverage
resource.description: Insurance Coverage

resource.name: Custodian
resource.description: Custodian

resource.name: Diagnostic Report
resource.description: The findings and interpretation of diagnostic tests performed on patients, groups of patients, products, substances, devices, and locations, and/or specimens derived from these. The report includes clinical context such as requesting provider information, and some mix of atomic results, images, textual and coded interpretations, and formatted representation of diagnostic reports.

resource.name: DocumentReference
resource.description: DocumentReference can contain Progress Notes, Advanced Directives, Consent Document, Radiology Report, Skin Wound, or Therapy Files

resource.name: Encounter
resource.description: An interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of a patient. Encounter is primarily used to record information about the actual activities that occurred, where Appointment is used to record planned activities.

resource.name: Family Member History
resource.description: Significant health conditions for a person related to the patient relevant in the context of care for the patient.

resource.name: Goal
resource.description: Describes the intended objective(s) for a patient, group or organization care, for example, weight loss, restoring an activity of daily living, obtaining herd immunity via immunization, meeting a process improvement objective, etc.

resource.name: Immunization
resource.description: Describes the event of a patient being administered a vaccine or a record of an immunization as reported by a patient, a clinician or another party.

resource.name: Immunization Status Code System
resource.description: PCC defined immunization statuses

resource.name: ImmunizationStatus
resource.description: Immunization Status

resource.name: Implantable Device
resource.description: Item used in healthcare.

resource.name: IndividualPronouns
resource.description: The pronouns to use when referring to an individual in verbal or written communication.

resource.name: Location
resource.description: This is a PointClickCare specific implementation of Location information.

resource.name: LOINC Order Code
resource.description: Extension for a single LOINC code

resource.name: LOINC Order Codes
resource.description: Extension to collect one or more LOINC order codes associated to a single order

resource.name: MedicareAdvantagePlan
resource.description: Medicare Advantage Plan

resource.name: Medication
resource.description: This is a PointClickCare specific implementation of Medication information. It includes codified drug details (RxNorm), form, strength, and unit of measure.

resource.name: Medication Dispense
resource.description: Indicates that a medication product is to be or has been dispensed for a named person/patient. This includes a description of the medication product (supply) provided and the instructions for administering the medication. The medication dispense is the result of a pharmacy system responding to a medication order.

resource.name: Medication Request
resource.description:
An order or request for both supply of the medication and the instructions for administration of the medication to a patient.
              This profile includes additional documentation for dose quantity, frequency, timing, indications, and pharmacy details.

resource.name: Observation
resource.description: Measurements and simple assertions made about a patient, device or other subject. This includes vitals, occupation, smoking status, pregnancy status and pregnancy intent.

resource.name: Occupation
resource.description: The occupation of an individual.

resource.name: Order Status Code System
resource.description: PCC defined order statuses

resource.name: OrderCategory
resource.description: Order Category

resource.name: OrderedBy
resource.description: Ordered By

resource.name: OrderType
resource.description: Order Type

resource.name: Organization
resource.description: This is a PointClickCare specific implementation of Organization information.

resource.name: Patient
resource.description: Demographics and other administrative information about an individual or animal receiving care or other health-related services.

resource.name: PayerDescription
resource.description: Payer Description

resource.name: PayerType
resource.description: Payer Type

resource.name: Practitioner
resource.description: This is a PointClickCare specific implementation of Practitioner information.

resource.name: Practitioner Role
resource.description: The role of a practitioner in the context of patient care.

resource.name: PreviousName
resource.description: The previous name of an individual.

resource.name: Procedure
resource.description: This resource provides the status of the payment for goods and services rendered, and the request and response resource references.

resource.name: Provenance
resource.description: Provenance of a resource is a record that describes entities and processes involved in producing and delivering or otherwise influencing that resource. Provenance provides a critical foundation for assessing authenticity, enabling trust, and allowing reproducibility. Provenance assertions are a form of contextual metadata and can themselves become important records with their own provenance. Provenance statement indicates clinical significance in terms of confidence in authenticity, reliability, and trustworthiness, integrity, and stage in lifecycle (e.g. Document Completion - has the artifact been legally authenticated), all of which may impact security, privacy, and trust policies.

resource.name: ProviderNumber
resource.description: Provider Number

resource.name: RecordedBy
resource.description: User or system who originally recorded the allergy

resource.name: Related Person
resource.description: Related Person for the patient

resource.name: ResolvedDate
resource.description: Date/time when the allergy was marked resolved

resource.name: RevisionBy
resource.description: User or system who last revised the allergy record

resource.name: RevisionDate
resource.description: Date/time when the allergy record was last revised

resource.name: RouteOfAdministration
resource.description: Route Of Administration

resource.name: ScheduleStartDate
resource.description: Specifies the start date and time for the medication schedule.

resource.name: Service Request
resource.description: A record of a request for service such as diagnostic investigations, treatments, or operations to be performed.

resource.name: Specimen
resource.description: This is a PointClickCare specific implementation of Specimen information.

resource.name: TimeCode
resource.description: Specifies time window or administration time range

resource.name: US Core Birth Sex Extension
resource.description: A code classifying the person's sex assigned at birth as specified by the [Office of the National Coordinator for Health IT (ONC)](https://www.healthit.gov/newsroom/about-onc). This extension aligns with the C-CDA Birth Sex Observation (LOINC 76689-9).

resource.name: US Core Gender Identity Extension
resource.description: An individual's personal sense of being a man, woman, boy, girl, nonbinary, or something else.

resource.name: USCoreEthnicity
resource.description: The individual's self-identified ethnicity.

resource.name: USCoreRace
resource.description: Concepts classifying the person into a named category of humans sharing common history, traits, geographical origin or nationality. The race codes used to represent these concepts are based upon the CDC Race and Ethnicity Code Set Version 1.0 which includes over 900 concepts for representing race and ethnicity of which 921 reference race.

resource.name: USCoreSex
resource.description: The individual's self-identified sex.

resource.name: USCoreTribalAffiliation
resource.description: The individual's self-identified tribal affiliation.

resource.description: A type of a manufactured item that is used in the provision of healthcare without being substantially changed through that activity. The device may be a medical or non-medical device.
